description: Blocks device commands that bypass a berth lease

hooks.command: command -v berth >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/berth" ]; then [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; else echo '{"systemMessage": "berth not found on PATH or in ~/.local/bin: the device guard is off. Install: https://github.com/LunabeeStudio/berth#install"}'; fi
if command -v berth >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec berth guard; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/berth" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/berth" guard; fi
